title: Is SoFi Stock a Buy After its Spectacular Investor Update?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA flips SoFi from CONDITIONAL_BUY, set on 24 October 2026, to BUY, raising his fair value to $22 against a market price of about $17, implying roughly 30% upside over 12-18 months. The trigger is the third-quarter beat and investor update: adjusted revenue of $1.37 billion, up 44%, adjusted EBITDA of $470 million, up 70%, full-year 2026 revenue guidance raised to $5 billion, and a 2027 outlook of about 27% growth at about a 20% net margin, alongside longer-term 2030 product targets. A record 1.2 million new members took the total above 17 million. His bull case is conservative management that underpromises and overdelivers, with the technology platform recovering for a second straight quarter, supporting a technology-like multiple. His bear case is concentration in personal loans, the largest segment at $30.9 billion of unpaid principal, where the default rate has risen to 5.1% from 4.77% as tariff and oil costs squeeze consumers. No other ticker is given a call in this video.
